data.name: Faraza
data.long_meaning: In Persian, Faraza means 'moonlet' or 'little moon'. This name is derived from the Persian word for moon, 'fararod', and the Persian suffix '-aza' which means 'little'. The name Faraza is often given to girls to symbolize the beauty and grace of the moon, as well as the nurturing and protective qualities associated with it.
